name: Thieving and Slayer Skilling Dummies
update: Treasure Hunter - Thieving and Slayer Skilling Dummies
desc: Thieving and Slayer dummies have been added to the game.

name: Christmas Advent Calendar
desc: Every day a previous promotion for that day.

name: Rare Token Store Boost
update: Treasure Hunter - Rare Token Store Boost
desc: Increased the chance of obtaining rare tokens and also decreased prices for the rewards in rare token store.

name: Novtumber Festival
desc: Grow Novtumber Festival seeds for Farming and Prayer experience, also featured increase chance for the skilling outfits of those skills.

name: Divine Simulacrum Outfits
desc: Combine all three outfits to create the Elder divination outfit.

name: Celebration of Fire
desc: Join the Celebration of Fire in the Lumbridge crater!

name: The Haunted Graveyard
desc: Collect candy corn to be exchanged for various cosmetics.

name: Lost Sword of Raddallin
update: Treasure Hunter - Lost Sword of Raddallin
desc: Use the basic and golden tools to uncover the Lost Sword of Raddallin!

name: Pet of Seasons
desc: Collect materials to combine into the rare Pet of Seasons!

name: Corrupted Chests
desc: Win prizes based on the level of corruption, such as the scrimshaw of sacrifice and the helm of corruption.

name: Time to Train
desc: Treasure Hunter offers many items that are beneficial during training in the Bonus XP Weekend.

name: Starfury Armour
desc: Collect Starlight ore to make Starlight and Starfury armour and weapons.

name: Dungeoneering Wildcards
desc: Collect wild cards that give 50% more Dungeoneering experience and tokens on the current floor when used.

name: Hearts of Fire
desc: Use Hearts of Ice to select the category of your next prize.

name: Death Lotus Training
desc: Complete challenges to collect pieces of a cosmetic outfit, cosmetic weapon overrides, and a new resting animation.

name: Bonus Chests
desc: Each key adds a charge to the bonus chest, which gives twice the items of a normal chest. The contents of the chest can be seen and reroll with every key used.

name: Slayer Masks 4
desc: New slayer masks have been added to aid while on a black demon, dagannoth, automaton, aquanite, ganodermic creature or airut task. Additionally, anyone who uses at least one key during this promotion obtains a troll slayer mask.

name: Prismania 3
desc: All lamps and stars on Treasure Hunter are prismatic, and give 50% more (bonus) experience.

name: New Portable Skill Stations
update: Treasure Hunter – New Portable Skill Stations
desc: It is possible to receive packages with skilling stations, which include three new types of skilling station - Firemaking, Fletching and Crafting.

name: Genie Returns!
desc: Using a lamp or star won from Treasure Hunter has a chance of spawning Karima, who gives the player extra bonus experience or coins.

name: Dragon Chests
desc: Dragon chests multiply the prize you'd receive from a regular chest, with the chance of more loot increasing (2x, 3x, and 4x) depending on the rarity of metal the chest is made of.

name: Summer Raffle
desc: Players can win mystery boxes from Treasure Hunter as well as from Reyna and through daily challenges, which gives them a chance at one of six exclusive summer cosmetics.

name: Advanced Pulse Cores
desc: Advanced pulse cores give 150% experience when worn, and a 2% experience boost (up to 10%) after exploding.

name: New Skilling Add-Ons
desc: Add-ons can be won to upgrade the sous chef's toque, botanist's mask, first age tiara and farmer's hat.

name: Astromancer Outfit
desc: Using astromancer credits, players can obtain god-related ceremonial robes, banner pets, and the astromancer outfit.

name: Smouldering Lamps
desc: Players can win smouldering lamps, which use bonus experience when giving their experience reward.

name: Dragon Trinkets
desc: Dragon trinkets give various bonuses when fighting chromatic dragons, as well as providing teleports.

name: Wonder Bar
desc: The wonder bar can be filled by using keys, in order to get a free item that is guaranteed to be of the selected rarity or higher.

name: Protean Logs
desc: Protean logs are stackable logs that can be used to get Firemaking or Fletching experience.

name: Dwarven Tools
desc: These tools can be used when fishing, mining or woodcutting, offering the choice between double produce and no experience, or double experience with no produce.

name: Pulse Cores
desc: pulse cores can be worn in the pocket slot to obtain double experience when training, and give a 2% experience boost (up to 10%) for 10 minutes when they explode.

name: Second Chance
desc: The result of each key can be rerolled at the cost of 10 Hearts of Ice.

name: Shark Attack
desc: Players can win pieces of shark outfits, which gives various bonuses when fishing.

name: All New Rares
desc: Old rares leave Treasure Hunter, and new ones take their place. Rare item tokens can be won to exchange for rare items.

name: Time to Train
desc: All chests contain prismatic stars and lamps, training dummies, and various other skilling-related items.

name: Valentine's 2015
desc: Players can win rose petals which can be exchanged for various Valentine-related items.

name: Bonus Chests
desc: Each key adds a charge to the bonus chest, which gives twice the items of a normal chest. The contents of the chest can be seen and reroll with every key used.

name: Protean Hides
desc: Protean hides are stackable items that give Crafting experience, scaling with the player's level.

name: Alchemist's Amulet
desc: The alchemist's amulet gives the player a daily amount of money. This is usually, but rarely the player can win.

name: Battleships
desc: Toy royal battleships can be won, which fight each other when deployed for Construction experience.

name: Smouldering Lamps
desc: Smouldering lamps use bonus experience when giving their reward.

name: Meteor Storm
desc: Meteorites and space dust give 75% extra (bonus) experience when used on one of the player's five lowest skills, and 25% otherwise.

name: Halloween - From This Weekend
update: Treasure Hunter: Halloween - From This Weekend
desc: Obtain Ghostweave fabric to create six outfits to trick-or-treat NPCs in Gielinor for chocolate rewards.

name: Rune Ethereals
desc: Obtain Ethereal outfits, which assist in your Runecrafting skill in multiple ways.

name: Protean Traps
desc: Protean traps can be used to catch a variety of animals for a higher amount of Hunter experience without receiving loot.

name: Skill Outfit Head Add-Ons
update: Treasure Hunter - Skill Outfit Head Add-Ons
desc: Add-ons can be won to upgrade the blacksmith's helmet, artisan's bandana, diviner's headwear and shaman's headdress.

name: Talk like a Pirate Day!
update: Treasure Hunter – Talk like a Pirate Day!
desc: Players can win doubloons which can be exchanged for a variety of pirate-themed items.

name: Rival Challenges
desc: Captain Haskell is back, and using challenge tokens, players can receive scaled-down daily challenges.

name: Ace of Trades
desc: Complete skill cards for a large experience reward.

name: Genie's Blessing
desc: When using a lamp or star won on Treasure Hunter, the player has a chance to spawn Karima, giving them extra bonus experience or coins.

name: Elite Training Dummies
desc: Training dummies can be used to obtain experience in the chosen combat style.

name: Totems of Wisdom
desc: Player can win essence of wisdom, which can be used to place town totems that give bonus experience to anyone who attunes to it.

name: Divine Recall
desc: Fading memories, when equipped in the pocket slot, give various bonuses when training Divination.

name: Blast from the Past II
update: Treasure Hunter – Blast from the Past II
desc: Old rares can once again be won on Treasure Hunter.

name: Lucky Clover Necklaces
desc: Clover necklaces can be won, which offer coins and prizes to win randomly.

name: Spring Cleaner
desc: The spring cleaner can take various drops and turn them into base materials or bonus experience, at the cost of springs.

name: Gemstone Golem Outfits
desc: Pieces of golem outfit can be won, which gives bonuses when training Mining.

name: Large Gnomeball & Recolourable Kit
update: Treasure Hunter: Large Gnomeball & Recolourable Kit
desc: The gnomeballer's kit and the large gnomeball could be won.

name: Prismania 2
desc: All lamps and stars on Treasure Hunter are prismatic and provide 50% more experience.

name: Cloak of Seasons
desc: Pieces of the Cloak of Spring, Cloak of Summer, Cloak of Autumn and Cloak of Winter can be won, which combine into the Cloak of Seasons.

name: Protean Smithing Bars
desc: Protean bars can be won, which give a fair chunk of Smithing experience when used.

name: Farming Skill Outfit
desc: The farmer's outfit is available, giving various Farming-related benefits when worn.

name: Portable Skill Stations
desc: Various portable skill stations can be won, for on-the-go Herblore, Smithing and Cooking experience as well as a sawmill that gives protean planks.

name: Easter Eggstravaganza
desc: Six eggs are available. 3 tradeable and 3 untradeable versions of items that transform the user into a lamb, rabbit, or chicken.

name: Heartfreezer
desc: Hearts of Ice are available from the Heartfreezer amulet and the number of categories that can be frozen per playing is doubled to 20.

name: Slayer Masks 3
desc: Six new Slayer masks are available from Treasure Hunter, each themed around well known Slayer monsters.

name: Skill Outfit Bonanza Returns
update: Treasure Hunter – Skill Outfit Bonanza Returns
desc: Skilling outfits are made more common.

name: Silverhawk Boots
desc: Debut of the Silverhawk boots. As such, the item has increased chances of being won.

name: Prismania
desc: All lamps and fallen stars are prismatic and give 50% extra bonus experience.

name: Blast from the Past
update: Treasure Hunter – Blast from the Past
desc: Rare items from the Squeal of Fortune that were discontinued with the release of Treasure Hunter are available as prizes.

name: Valentine's 2014
desc: Valentine love notes are available on Treasure Hunter and as monster drops. They can be exchanged for chocolates to earn a new title, or they can be exchanged for emotes and equipment representing one emotion either love or hate.

name: Treasure Hunter
desc: The Mimic pet is available for a limited time to start off the new minigame, Treasure Hunter.

name: Celebration Lamps
desc: Almost all skill items have been replaced with celebration lamps - prismatic lamps which give regular experience in one skill, and 5% of that amount of experience in all other skills. Every 10th lamp used increased experience gained by 2%.

name: Christmas Advent Calendar
desc: Get a free item everyday from the calendar (or claim them later) and each day there's a previous promotion making a return to Treasure Hunter, but only for that day.

name: Rainbow's End
desc: Get the rainbow cape and amulet from Treasure Hunter and use the multiplier unlocks to increase the amount of items obtained per key.

desc: 2nd Chance Tuesday.

name: Boat to the Arc
update: Treasure Hunter - Boat to the Arc Event
desc: To get to the Eastern Lands when they launch on 25th July, we're going to need a bigger boat! Join your RuneScape friends and use a different skill each day to construct a ship, all whilst unlocking fantastic rewards, including an XP-boosting, item-dropping backpack!

name: Dragon Chests
desc: 2nd Chance Tuesday.

desc: Meteor Storm is back with a bang. Get your hands on Meteorites and Space Dust which have replaced standard XP lamps and stars.

name: Lava lantern
desc: 2nd Chance Tuesday.

desc: Get both extra fast Bonus XP and stacking XP buffs as Advanced Pulse Cores make a return to Treasure Hunter!

desc: Collect the pieces to create seasonal outfits which together can be combined into one Armour of Seasons!
